How it works

  1. 1

    Open from the toolbar

    Click the Reminders icon to see Today, Scheduled, All and Flagged at a glance.

  2. 2

    Add a reminder

    Tap +, enter a title and notes, pick a list, date, time, priority and flag.

  3. 3

    Get reminded on time

    When it’s due, a fullscreen alert appears — complete or dismiss it in one tap.

Frequently asked questions

What do I get for free?

Up to 3 reminders, 3 lists and 5 quick notes. Premium removes every limit.

Do I need an account?

No. Your reminders are stored locally in your browser.

Can I use my own notification sound?

Yes, with Premium you can upload MP3 files as reminder sounds.

How much is Premium?

A one-time payment from $12 for one browser — no subscription. Packs of 2, 3 and 5 licenses cost $19, $25 and $35.
